title: In Open Object Rexx (ooRexx) before 5.2.0, RXAPI mishandles nameArg and userid bounds checking, possibly leading to…
description: Open Object Rexx (ooRexx) versions before 5.2.0 contain a vulnerability in the RXAPI component where improper bounds checking of nameArg and userid parameters can lead to arbitrary code execution. This flaw allows an attacker with local access to craft malicious messages that exploit this weakness. The vulnerability is rated critical with a high CVSS score of 9.3, indicating severe confidentiality, integrity, and availability impacts.
